name: Luke Wroblewski
bio: Luke Wroblewski (LukeW) is a digital product leader and author of Mobile First, Web Form Design, and Site-Seeing. Public career includes Google product leadership after Polar’s acquisition, earlier Yahoo and eBay design roles, and ongoing writing at lukew.com. Known for pragmatic mobile and form design craft.
highlights: Author of Mobile First and Web Form Design.
Public lukew.com essays on product and input craft.
Career spanning Google, Polar, Yahoo, eBay design/product.
